why_ai: Generative AI has commoditised recorded explanation, the sector's core product.
why_clarity: Enrolments are high volume, but whether anyone learned is never observed.
why_digital: Video, quizzes and certificates delivered entirely online to global learners.

why_ai: Scheduling, grouping and nudging are operational tasks software can automate.
why_clarity: Attendance and completion give measurable feedback on cohort operations.
why_digital: Cohorts scheduled and moderated entirely online.

why_ai: Ranking and matching are recommendation models with no human role.
why_clarity: Completion after enrolment scores each match within weeks.
why_digital: Search and ranking run entirely inside the platform.

why_ai: Decay detection is automatable and AI can regenerate outdated explanation.
why_clarity: Obsolete content is checkable against current tools, though signals lag.
why_digital: Course content and external signals monitored on screen.

why_ai: AI-enabled cheating raises demand for credentials employers can trust.
why_clarity: Job outcomes after credentialing are almost never observed.
why_digital: Assessments and credentials issued and verified online.

why_ai: Knowledge tracing is a model inference task with established methods.
why_clarity: Mastery estimates are checked against the learner's next attempts.
why_digital: Behavioural logs modelled entirely inside the platform.

why_ai: Credible capability claims gain value as AI commoditises explanation.
why_clarity: No agreed definition of learning exists and real outcomes go unobserved.
why_digital: Behavioural records analysed entirely inside the platform.

why_ai: Exercise generation and feedback on work are prime LLM tasks.
why_clarity: Exercises recur at scale, but feedback quality is partly subjective.
why_digital: Practice and feedback delivered entirely online.

why_ai: The same twenty questions with existing answers are directly automatable.
why_clarity: Repetitive questions with known answers resolved and checked quickly.

why_ai: Learners buy from named experts, though generic instruction is commoditised by AI.
why_clarity: Teaching quality is taste and each creator runs the business differently.
why_digital: Courses recorded, marketed and sold online.

why_ai: Dropout prediction and nudging are automatable by models and AI tutors.
why_clarity: Dropout is visible in data and re-engagement is measured within weeks.
why_digital: Learner behaviour tracked and interventions sent online.
